title: Manhansuck (Pipe's Neck Creek)
summary: Manhansuck is a Southold placename for Pipe's Neck Creek, just west of Greenport. The name belongs to a creek and outlet setting near Pipe's Cove.
address_label: Pipe's Cove / Pipe's Neck Creek, west of Greenport
map_geometry_source: Approximate modern Pipe's Cove / Pipe's Neck Creek location based on Tooker's description west of Greenport; coordinate is general.
translation_content:
The name is interpreted as an island brook or an island at the outlet, connecting manhan with island and -suck with brook or outlet. Related entries point back to Hashamomuk Neck and Sonnquoquas.

Why Place Names Matter

“The popular tendency to change a word, or name, to something commonly understood is very strong.”

— W. H. Duignan, Worcestershire Place Names (1905), Internet Archive scan leaf 28
whereintheworld_content: The map placement at the modern Pipe's Cove / Pipe's Neck Creek area west of Greenport is a general location reference for a named creek and outlet, not an exact reconstruction of the 1640 landscape.
